subject: Door
text: Opening a Door requires a Key, which can only be used once per door.

evidence.quote:
You can open Doors if you have a Key.  Use Keys wisely.  You can only use a
Key once and you need a Key for each Door.

subject: Princess Gwalin
text: Princess Gwalin is the daughter of King Lorik and must be rescued from the swamp cave.

evidence.quote:
Princess Gwalin - The daughter of Lorik. You must rescue her from the swamp
cave.

subject: Wynn
text: Wynn is located in Cantlin and provides information regarding Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: Wynn - See this man in Cantlin for information regarding Erdrick's Armor.

subject: King Lorik
text: King Lorik takes half of the player's gold upon death.

evidence.quote:
He wants you to restore peace and defeat the
Dragonlord and knows you need gold to buy weapons and armor to do so but still
takes half your gold when you die anyway.
